patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: All four of us — headache, sick, dizzy. It started Saturday when we finally turned the heat on. I thought it was food poisoning, but nobody ate the same thing.
clinical.presentationShort: 36yo F — 2 days headache, nausea and dizziness; the entire household affected simultaneously since the furnace was switched on.
clinical.presentationLong: 36-year-old female with two days of headache, nausea and dizziness, with every member of the household affected at the same time since the furnace was switched on.

diagnosis.disposition: Acute → high-flow oxygen immediately, carboxyhaemoglobin level, consider hyperbaric therapy; she must not go back to that house
diagnosis.why: That SpO₂ of 99% is a lie: a pulse oximeter cannot tell carboxyhaemoglobin from oxyhaemoglobin. The diagnosis is in the story — everyone in the house sick at once, and better when they leave it.
diagnosis.redFlag: An entire household ill at once since the heating was switched on — carbon monoxide until proven otherwise.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: a hispanic 36-year-old woman in a winter coat still zipped up, seated on a blue padded clinic chair
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting with elbows on knees, heels of both hands pressed against her temples
aiImageGeneration.expression: nauseated and squinting against the light
aiImageGeneration.lookSeverity: unwell with a severe headache but alert and talking
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. Subject: a hispanic 36-year-old woman in a winter coat still zipped up, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting with elbows on knees, heels of both hands pressed against her temples. Expression: nauseated and squinting against the light. Clearly visible: hands pressed against the temples; slightly flushed complexion; eyes squeezed half shut. Overall: unwell with a severe headache but alert and talking. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
